title: Apify Alternatives: Managed Scraping Made Simple
snippet:
The right Apify alternative depends on *which Apify workflow you are actually leaving*: **MrScraper** (managed REST APIs, AI prompt extraction, auditable token billing, $2.50/GB proxies), **Bright Data** (enterprise proxy catalog and access add-on), **Oxylabs** (global proxy networks), **Zyte** (page access layer selection), **ScrapingBee** (simple HTML API), and **Firecrawl** (LLM markdown ingestion).

Apify's platform pricing combines subscription tiers, Compute Unit (CU) usage, proxy bandwidth, and dataset storage. Published rates (verified via [Apify official pricing](https://apify.com/pricing)):
| Apify plan tier | Monthly cost | Included platform usage credits | Compute Unit rate ($/CU)* | Included proxy access |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **Free** | $0/mo | $5/month | $0.40/CU | Datacenter proxies |
| **Starter** | $49/mo | $49/month | $0.40/CU | Datacenter and Residential proxies |
| **Scale** | $499/mo | $499/month | $0.35/CU | Priority Residential and Datacenter |
| **Business** | $999/mo | $999/month | $0.30/CU | Premium Residential and Dedicated support |

[MrScraper's Web Scraper API](https://mrscraper.com/web-scraper-api) uses a resource token model with per-request auditability:
- **Manual Scraper and Web Scraper API**: 1 token per 30s runtime + 1 token per 0.2 MB bandwidth.
- **AI Scraper**: 1 token per 30s runtime + 1 token per ~1,000 input tokens + 1 token per ~200 output tokens + 5 fixed trace tokens per run.
- **Per-request telemetry**: Every response returns `token_usage`, `bandwidth_usage`, `runtime`, and `x-status-code` headers.
